detail.command:
set -e
MERGE=571525c92ea7825072831452d65574ef523d2eb9
H=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo "HEAD=$H"
if [ "$H" != "$MERGE" ]; then git cat-file -e "$MERGE^{commit}"; git reset --hard "$MERGE"; fi
git log --oneline -3
git status --short
grep -rn "^<<<<<<<" src/ && { echo "MARKERS LEFT"; exit 4; } || true
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; else npm install --no-audit --no-fund; fi
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
